feed.title: Google Cloud: Cloud Tasks
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Cloud Tasks

entry.content:
Cloud Tasks support for the following is available in Preview:

  • Set retry parameters when creating a task and override the queue-level retry configuration for the task.
  • Create a batch of tasks and add the batch to an existing queue.
  • Delete a batch of tasks from a queue.
entry.summary: Cloud Tasks now supports setting retry parameters when creating a task, creating a batch of tasks, and deleting a batch of tasks. These features are available in preview.
entry.title: Feature: Cloud Tasks adds new features

entry.content:
Cloud Tasks is available in the following locations:

  • me-central1 (Doha, Qatar)
  • me-central2 (Dammam, Saudi Arabia)
entry.summary: Cloud Tasks is now available in two new Middle East locations: me-central1 (Doha, Qatar) and me-central2 (Dammam, Saudi Arabia). This expansion offers greater choice and proximity for users in the region.
entry.title: Change: Cloud Tasks now in Middle East
